name: Protective Asset Allocation - Commodity Universe + 15% Vol Target
description: Keller & Keuning PAA applied to commodities with VUTY bonds as safe asset, scaled to 15% vol overlay. Allocates to commodities proportionally to how many pass their 12-month SMA trend test, shifting remaining weight to VUTY bonds when commodity markets are in downtrend. Provides regime-aware drawdown control across commodity markets.
